metadata.description: Claude Code companions for the r2mcp memory server

plugins.name: r2mcp-memory
plugins.description: r2mcp memory beside the chat: memories related to what you ask, and at each turn's end a cheap gate and a fork that propose what to remember, with Save/Skip and a mode switch on the pane. Any memory opens in a reader with a readable layout and an optional model summary. A Claude Code mod; needs this repo's server connected as the MCP server "memory".
